sources.primary_title: Architecting the Intelligent Enterprise: Link Development’s Frontier Ascent at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Link Development has announced it will launch "Frontier Ascent," a governed agentic AI operating model, at LEAP 2026 alongside its partner Microsoft. Unlike piecemeal AI deployments, Frontier Ascent provides a complete transformation journey from consulting to implementation, delivering a governed operating model that clients own and operate. The model integrates the full Microsoft AI stack, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, and Agent 365. It also features a Sovereign Data & AI offering to ensure data stays within Saudi Arabia, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The launch includes proprietary products built on Microsoft technologies, such as SellBig (real-estate CRM), ServeStream (low-code service automation), and Globby 4.0 (an agentic chatbot). This angle is distinct from existing coverage as it specifically focuses on Link Development's new comprehensive AI operating model and its integration with the Microsoft ecosystem, rather than general event overviews or other specific product launches.
sources.verified_key_facts: Link Development is launching Frontier Ascent, a governed agentic AI operating model, at LEAP 2026; The launch is in partnership with Microsoft, where Link Development is recognized as a Frontier Partner; Frontier Ascent integrates the full Microsoft AI stack, including Copilot, Foundry, Fabric, and Agent 365; The model includes a Sovereign Data & AI offering to ensure data remains in Saudi Arabia; Link Development will showcase proprietary products like SellBig, ServeStream, and Globby 4.0; The initiative targets transformation goals aligned with Saudi Vision 2030; Ehab Geddawy and Anas Saad are listed as speakers for the event.
